title: Use Newtake’s 9-panel storyboard and 3D Director Stage to establish the…
content: Use Newtake’s 9-panel storyboard and 3D Director Stage to establish the environment’s spatial relationships first, then generate each shot/scene around that layout to maintain consistent spatial logic across a sequence with Seedance 2.5 support.
tips: Use Newtake’s 9-panel storyboard and 3D Director Stage to establish the environment’s spatial relationships first, then generate each shot/scene around that layout to maintain consistent spatial logic across a sequence with Seedance 2.5 support.

es.content: Usa el storyboard de 9 paneles de Newtake y el 3D Director Stage para establecer primero las relaciones espaciales del entorno, y luego genera cada plano/escena en torno a esa disposición para mantener una lógica espacial coherente a lo largo de toda la secuencia con compatibilidad para Seedance 2.5.

fr.content: Utilisez le storyboard à 9 cases et la 3D Director Stage de Newtake pour établir d’abord les relations spatiales de l’environnement, puis générez chaque plan/scène autour de cette mise en page afin de maintenir une logique spatiale cohérente tout au long de la séquence avec la prise en charge de Seedance 2.5.

ja.content: Newtakeの9パネル・ストーリーボードと3D Director Stageを使って、まず環境内の空間関係を把握し、そのレイアウトに基づいて各ショット／シーンを生成することで、Seedance 2.5対応のシーケンス全体で一貫した空間ロジックを維持します。

ko.content: Newtake의 9패널 스토리보드와 3D Director Stage를 활용해 먼저 환경의 공간 관계를 설정한 다음, 그 레이아웃을 바탕으로 각 샷/장면을 생성하여 Seedance 2.5 지원과 함께 시퀀스 전반에 걸쳐 일관된 공간 논리를 유지하세요.

pt.content: Use o storyboard de 9 painéis e o 3D Director Stage da Newtake para estabelecer primeiro as relações espaciais do ambiente e, em seguida, gere cada plano/cena com base nesse layout para manter uma lógica espacial consistente ao longo de uma sequência com suporte ao Seedance 2.5.

zh.content: 先使用 Newtake 的 9 宫格分镜和 3D Director Stage 来建立环境中的空间关系，然后再围绕该布局生成每个镜头/场景，以在支持 Seedance 2.5 的情况下保持整个序列中一致的空间逻辑。
